findings.topic: StVO 1960 §42 weekend/holiday ban and §42(6) night ban
findings.authority: Bundeskanzleramt – RIS OGD API v2.6 (Bundesrecht konsolidiert)
findings.document_version: StVO 1960 §42 idF BGBl. I Nr. 17/2026, Inkrafttretensdatum 2026-04-24 (RIS doc NOR40276972, veröffentlicht/geändert 2026-04-23); same document returned for FassungVom=2027-11-19
findings.finding: §42(1): Sat 15:00-24:00 and Sundays + statutory public holidays 00:00-22:00 ban on lorries with trailer where MAM of lorry OR trailer >3.5 t. §42(2): same times for lorries, articulated vehicles and self-propelled work machines MAM >7.5 t. §42(2a) airport/combined-transport (65 km radius) exemptions; §42(3) enumerated exemptions incl. slaughter cattle, post, periodicals, beverage supply to excursion areas, urgent repairs, towing/breakdown, disaster, road maintenance, refuse, scheduled-line vehicles, showmen, army, humanitarian, and journeys within built-up areas on the last two Saturdays before 24 Dec. §42(5) minister may decree route-specific calendar bans (e.g. Ferienreiseverkehr). §42(6): night ban 22:00-05:00 for lorries MAM >7.5 t, exemptions road service, army, low-noise vehicles with §8b(4) KDV certificate. Body SHA-256 identical to dataset at-stvo42 content_sha256 (5cad29b8...).
findings.notes: Dataset rules at-saturday/at-sunday/at-night end valid_to 2026-12-31 only because of the review span; the statute itself continues into 2027. Dataset encodes the >7.5t thresholds; the §42(1) >3.5t lorry-or-trailer combination threshold is described in source findings but should be checked in the rule vehicle scope.

findings.topic: Tyrol sectoral driving ban A12 (Sektorales Fahrverbot-Verordnung LGBl. 44/2016)
findings.authority: Land Tirol via RIS OGD Landesrecht
findings.document_version: §3 idF LGBl. 81/2019; §4 idF LGBl. 54/2026 (Inkrafttreten 2026-08-03 per RIS)
findings.finding: §3: A12 km 6.35 (Langkampfen) – km 72.00 (Ampass), both directions, lorries/articulated MAM >7.5 t and lorry+trailer sum >7.5 t banned (all hours, no time window) when carrying: waste (EWC), stones/earth/spoil, round timber/cork, vehicles L1e-L7e/M1/M2/N1, non-ferrous & iron ores, steel (except rebar/structural steel for construction sites), marble/travertine, ceramic tiles; from 2020 also paper/cardboard, liquid mineral-oil products, cement/lime/burnt gypsum, pipes/hollow sections, cereals. §4 exemptions: core-zone (Imst, Innsbruck-Land/Stadt, Kufstein, Schwaz) source or destination with Euro VI; extended-zone source AND destination with Euro VI; rail-terminal pre/on-carriage Hall/Wörgl; Euro VI first registered after 31 Aug 2018 (with document); battery-electric/H2; army/aid. LGBl. 54/2026 (kundgemacht 2026-07-07) only added a temporary lit. h Euro VI exemption for the Mühltaltunnel works 23 Jul–2 Aug 2026 and expired with 2026-08-02.
findings.notes: Dataset already flags AT_TYROL_SECTORAL_BAN_GOODS_LIST_NOT_ENCODED; this evidence supplies the goods list. The only 2026 amendment has lapsed.

findings.topic: Federal route-calendar ordinances 2026 (Fahrverbotskalender 2026, A10 spring/summer 2026, Luegbrücke 2026)
findings.authority: BMIMI ordinances via RIS OGD API v2.6
findings.document_version: BGBl. II 77/2026 (§1 hash identical to dataset at-cal e8144933...), II 121/2026, II 190/2026, II 338/2025 idF II 70/2026 — all with Außerkrafttretensdatum 2026-12-31
findings.finding: None of the four 2026 calendar ordinances contains any date in November or December 2026 (last dates: Lueg 3 Oct 2026 07-15 / 2 Oct 07-22; Fahrverbotskalender 3 Oct 2026 00-15; A10 summer 19 Sep 2026). All expire 2026-12-31.
findings.notes: Resolves coverage failure AT_LUEG_A10_ROUTE_ORDINANCES_NOT_REVIEWED_FOR_DECEMBER_2026 for the published 2026 ordinances: no Dec 2026 entries in them. Does not exclude a not-yet-published winter ordinance (see AT-07).

findings.topic: 2027 route-calendar ordinances (Fahrverbotskalender 2027 incl. summer Ferienreise Saturdays, A10 2027, Luegbrücke 2027, Winterfahrverbotskalender 2026/27)
findings.finding: No BGBl. II ordinance for 2027 (Fahrverbotskalender 2027, A10 calendar 2027, Luegbrücke 2027) and no Winterfahrverbotskalender for 2026/27 published as of 2026-11-19. Historical pattern: Luegbrücke ordinances published 2024-12-27 (II 409/2024) and 2025-12-30 (II 338/2025); winter calendars published Dec/Jan (II 383/2024 A10 2024/25, II 2/2024, II 3/2023); summer Fahrverbotskalender published Mar–Jun (II 77/2026 on 2026-03-31). Pattern is a discovery lead only, not evidence of future content.
findings.notes: Summer 2027 weekend Ferienreise ban regulation: NOT published. Do not infer absence of 2027 calendar bans; Lueg works and summer calendars have been issued every year 2005–2026.
